description: Reviewed classification of every unique --unfreed=warn missing-free site and every local suppression in the M2 pilots (M2.3). Classes: invocation-lifetime (intentional retention to process exit), temporary-cleanup (work left to retire), proof-limit (a diagnostic or proof limit).

suppressions.justification: the shared sentinel for a parse that threw is stored in the retained result list and lives to process exit (D261 test adapter)
OwnershipKernel holds the analyzer's input nodes and slots, the tracker and the evidence store; nodes and their versions are invocation-lived under D262 and the adapter exits after writing its result
EvidenceKernel holds the evidence store, its budget and the colliding nodes whose sites, events and joins are invocation-lived evidence payloads under D262
InputKernel owns the span and type that the rejected IR inputs borrow; admitted IR is invocation-lived under D262, and so are inputs rejected before analysis
an allocation node is an invocation-lived analyzer input under D262; this one carries the freed input state the factory rejects
